title: Microtek-Online UPS i-MAXX-5.5KVA 192V (1PH IN-1PH Out) Pure Sinewave, Multicolour
description: * DSP Technology with IGBT Based Inverter. * Transformer Based Online UPS. * Inbuilt OVCD(Over Voltage Cut-Off Device) with Surge Protection. * Smart LCD Display for Real-time information. * EMI / RFI Noise Filter. * CVCF (constant Voltage Constant Frequency) * Wide Input Voltage Range * Conformal Coated PCB Assemblies to withstand Harsh Environment * Extended Charger capacity expansion to 4amps. (Optional) on demand * Advanced PFC Technology * Advanced Battery Management * Hot Stand-by, Cold Start & RS-232/USB Port Features available. * Short Circuit and Overload Protection * Built-In Maintenance Bypass & Static Bypass Switch. * Over Temperature Protection. * Specially designed to suit Indian Power and Environment Conditions * Generator Compatible (Generator Capacity required for Stand-By Source should be 2.5 times of the UPS capacity). * Configurable Output Voltage Settings. * Output Frequency Fixed at 50Hz or can be synchronised with Input Frequency. * Protection from DC Fan failure. * In-built Over Voltage Cut-Off Device.
Name: Microtek-Online UPS i-MAXX-5.5KVA 192V (1PH IN-1PH Out) Pure Sinewave, Multicolour
